labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Usage question: track() accepts complete_style, which sets the completed bar colour.

body:
This looks like a duplicate of #637, which asks the same question and is still open, so please continue the discussion there.

The colour of the completed bar is set with the `complete_style` parameter of `rich.progress.track()`, for example `track(items, complete_style="green")`. The same parameter is available on `BarColumn` if you build a `Progress` yourself. See [rich/progress.py](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py).

For usage questions, please use [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
